name: Juicy attribution & profit
description: Juicy combines profit tracking, marketing attribution, and order analytics into one AI-ready connector, giving Claude the context it needs to analyze your business in seconds. Ask anything from today's profit and your best-performing products to the attribution touchpoints and marketing channels behind every purchase.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Juicy attribution & profit to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Juicy attribution & profit to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://juicy.easyapps.cloud/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Juicy attribution & profit MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Juicy attribution & profit provides these MCP tools: get_order_detail, get_orders, get_profit_loss, and get_shop_stats.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Juicy attribution & profit?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Juicy attribution & profit in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Juicy attribution & profit MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Juicy attribution & profit requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Juicy attribution & profit is developed by Juicy. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
